_doc: The game content on Cloudflare Pages, split by directory over two projects (deploy/pages/README.md
'Asset CDN'): Pages takes at most 20,000 files a deployment and the tree has more. One file for the
deploy (deploy/pages/assets_cdn.py, assets-cdn.sh, stage.py -> the page's kn-config.json) and the
updates store on kru (tools/release/kn-updates.py -> the launcher manifest's assets.mirrors, which the
launcher and the native client's on-demand fetch route by). Paths are below assets/.
shards: the first one without 'prefixes' takes everything the others do not ('default'); a path goes
to the shard with the longest matching prefix. Keep every shard under max_files (assets_cdn.py
fails over the Pages limit, warns over max_files): check with deploy/pages/assets-cdn.sh --dry-run.
download: kru (host nginx + OpenResty, role kn_dl_origin): the full tree, /updates/ and everything in
exclude; the mirror's source and the clients' fallback. The default shard's _redirects send the other
shards' prefixes there with a 301 (old clients ask assets.krunk.io for everything), kru_only and
live: false until assets.krunk.io / assets1.krunk.io are the Pages custom domains (runbook): the page
and the manifest route by shard only then; before, they use the pages.dev names for tests only.
